acceptance.given: The package validator completes successfully for a target package and emits its validation receipt.

oracle.expected: The receipt is parseable and contains trusted target content identity (manifest_sha256 or equivalent immutable content hash) and descriptive resolved validator version/identity; an isolated fixture removing either provenance field fails while target, capability, and all non-target inputs remain unchanged.
forbidden: A successful receipt omits trusted content identity.
A successful receipt omits the descriptive validator version.
The provenance fixture changes inputs other than the isolated removed field.
A provenance mutation is accepted as a successful validation.
oracle.observable: Inspect the JSON emitted by scripts/sc/skill_package_replay.py validate-package or replay-package, then run the existing receipt-provenance mutation test with each field removed independently and compare the observed exit status and unchanged-input hashes.

acceptance.then: The successful receipt records trusted content identity and descriptive validator version.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the receipt-provenance mutation fixture that removes target_package.manifest_sha256 (or the trusted content identity field) from an otherwise identical successful receipt; expect deterministic artifact-integrity rejection.

Run the receipt-provenance mutation fixture that removes resolved_validator descriptive version/identity from an otherwise identical successful receipt; expect deterministic artifact-integrity rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make successful package-validation receipts carry immutable target content identity and descriptive validator identity/version, and enforce isolated rejection when either provenance field is removed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback restores the prior receipt emission/schema validation behavior without changing persisted runtime state or requiring data migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: validator execution succeeds -> receipt is emitted with target content identity and descriptive validator identity/version -> isolated removal of either field is rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A successful receipt contains both required provenance fields and both independent field-removal fixtures fail deterministically with all other inputs held constant.
